package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-core-utils/lib/coreutils"
)

func main() {
	codec := coreutils.WireCodec{}
	key, _ := coreutils.NamespacedKey("core utils", "consumer")
	date, _ := coreutils.NewWireDate(2026, 7, 21)
	timeOfDay, _ := coreutils.NewWireTime(1, 2, 3)
	duration, _ := coreutils.ParseIsoDuration("PT1S")
	zone, _ := coreutils.ParseIanaTimezone("UTC")
	_, _ = codec.DecodeDate(codec.EncodeDate(date))
	_, _ = codec.DecodeTime(codec.EncodeTime(timeOfDay))
	instant, _ := codec.EncodeInstant(time.Now())
	_, _ = codec.DecodeInstant(instant)
	_, _ = codec.DecodeDuration(codec.EncodeDuration(duration))
	_, _ = codec.DecodeTimezone(codec.EncodeTimezone(zone))
	_ = coreutils.FormatRFC3339UTC
	_ = coreutils.IsIanaTimezone("UTC")
	_ = coreutils.IANATimeZoneRelease
	_ = coreutils.C0Temporal.DigestPayload()
	_ = coreutils.DeepClone(map[string]any{"value": []any{"x"}})
	_ = coreutils.DeepMerge(map[string]any{}, map[string]any{})
	_ = coreutils.DeepMergeAll(map[string]any{})
	_ = coreutils.CanonicalConfigKey("client-id")
	_ = coreutils.ConfigKeysMatch("client_id", "clientId")
	_ = coreutils.CoerceEnvironmentScalar("true")
	_, _ = coreutils.EnvironmentToNestedMap(map[string]string{"APP_LIST__0": "one"}, "APP_")
	_ = coreutils.Sleep(context.Background(), 0)
	_, _ = coreutils.StableHash(map[string]any{"value": 1})
	_, _ = coreutils.MapConcurrent(context.Background(), []int{1}, 1,
		func(_ context.Context, value int) (int, error) { return value, nil })
	_, _ = coreutils.HashFile(context.Background(), nil, "path")
	_, _ = coreutils.NowWireInstant(nil)
	fmt.Println(coreutils.Slugify(key), date.String(), timeOfDay.String(), duration.String(), zone.String())
}
